ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Given the graph of the linear function $y=kx-b$ as shown in the figure, what is the solution set of the inequality $kx-1>b$ with respect to $x$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $\because kx-1>b$,\\
$\therefore kx-b>1$,\\
$\therefore$ the graph of the linear function lies above the line $y=1$. Observing the graph, we find that $x>4$,\\
$\therefore$ the solution set for the inequality $kx-1>b$ in terms of $x$ is $\boxed{x>4}$.
